gallery.title: File:Montana de colores Cusco (Vinicunca) y Valle Rojo por Inka Time.jpg
gallery.source: Montana de colores Cusco (Vinicunca) y Valle Rojo por Inka Time
gallery.description:
The Mountain is located in the Cordillera del Vilcanota at 5,200 meters above sea level, in the district of Pitumarca, Cusco region.
The mountain of colors or Rainbow mountain, is a beautiful mountain of the Peruvian Andes whose characteristic is the amount of colors in its surface due to minerals and different types of rock.
Its beauty is on the surface, therefore, it is not allowed to walk in it, for a conservation issue.
To appreciate it in all its splendor, you climb the mountain in front of the Rainbow Mountain.

From where, in addition to seeing the Vinicunca, you can also observe breathtaking views of the Ausangate, and the entire valley to its surroundings.

gallery.title: File:Alberto Fujimori en 1991.jpg
gallery.artist: Christian Lambiotte /  European Communities, 1991 / EC - Audiovisual Service
gallery.credit: Visit of Alberto Fujimori, President of Peru, to the CEC
gallery.description:
Visit of Alberto Fujimori, President of Peru, to the CEC.
Jacques Delors, President of the CEC, and Abel Matutes, Member of the CEC in charge of Mediterranean Policy, Relations with Latin America and Asia (excluding Far East) and North-South Relations, received Alberto Fujimori, President of Peru, Carlos Torres y Torres Lara, Peruvian Prime Minister and Minister for Foreign Affairs. Discussions related to the recovery and good management of the Peruvian economy. The Commission declared itself satisfied with the results concerning the reintegration of Peru into the international economy. Also discussed were the efforts made by the country in the field of the internal peace-making process of Peru and the policies launched to tackle the issue of drug trafficking. Furthermore, cooperation between the Community and Peru was considered positive. Considering difficulties faced by his country, Alberto Fujimori submitted requests for financial support from the Commission, in the social and humanitarian fields as well as for the economic revitalisation of Peru, and requested the Commission support as regards the reintegration of Peru into the international financial circuits. It as also been decided to co-finance a joint-venture with the IFU, within the framework of the ECIP (European Community Investment Partners).

gallery.title: File:Nichos en el cementerio de Umuto 01.jpg
gallery.description: Nichos en el Cementerio de la Comunidad Campesina de Umuto, en el distrito de El Tambo, provincia de Huancayo, departamento de Junín, Perú. Este pabellón y los difuntos corresponden a algunos que fueron trasladados desde tumbas cercanas en el año 2013, por ello el tamaño reducido de los nichos dado que en el momento del traslado los restos de los difuntos solo se trataban de pocos huesos. Se observan entre las flores: gladiolos, rosas, astromelias, crisántemos, alhelíes, y claveles.

gallery.title: File:A man paints and cleans.jpg
gallery.description: A man paints and cleans the roofs of niches stacked on top of each other at Virgen de Lourdes Cemetery, known as Nueva Esperanza, in the Villa María del Triunfo district of Lima, Peru, on Friday, Nov. 1, 2025. Each year on All Saints Day, families visit and beautify the graves of their loved ones in one of the largest cemeteries in Latin America.

gallery.filename: A pastor, dressed in the traditional purple robe, reads psalms.jpg
gallery.title: File:A pastor, dressed in the traditional purple robe, reads psalms.jpg
gallery.description: A pastor, dressed in the traditional purple robe, reads psalms to worshippers resting after climbing the hill to visit the graves of their deceased loved ones on Nov. 1, All Saints Day, at Virgen de Lourdes Cemetery, known as Nueva Esperanza, in the Villa María del Triunfo district of Lima, Peru. The reading of psalms is part of the acts of faith and reflection that mark the day, as thousands of families remember and honor their loved ones.
